title: Anonymous Magpie single-model weekly capacity, round2

series.name: magpie
series.naming_note: The Magpie research series on main has only round1 (local + Tokyo, cutoff 2026-10-21). This file is round2. It is a different question: one subscription account, one model, 100% of the weekly quota, valued at official API rates for the observed cache mix.

adoption_reason: Conditional observational evidence for two anonymous accounts. Devin plan tier is not verified in the logs. Estimates are not summed across accounts and do not replace adopted rows. CONVENTIONS.md section 3 requires maintainer resolution before any adoption.

conventions.role: 定义当前采用、计算、绘图和公开发布共用的项目口径
conventions.formula: 订阅价 ÷ 用户实际能用到的月 token = 真实混合单价

exchangeRate.units: CNY per USD; legacy field usdPerCny stores this direction
exchangeRate.labelZh: 中国外汇交易中心中间价，新华社转载
exchangeRate.note: 2026-09-05为周六，采用最近交易日9月4日中间价；非银行卡实际结算价。100美元=677.87人民币。

conventions.unmeteredPolicy: 订阅内明确不占额度、无并发上限的模型：真实单价记 0、显示为 ≈$0/MTok（分母无界，趋于 0 而非精确 0），X 轴以专用‘不计额度’刻度位表示、不进对数换算；参与前沿。促销口径必须标截止日并在到期后复核。

conventions.tokenPolicy: 所有 token 一视同仁；美元额度和三段价统一按项目标准负载折算

standardTokenMix.labelZh: 项目统一标准负载：缓存读取97% / 普通输入2.5% / 输出0.5%
standardTokenMix.labelEn: Project standard workload: 97% cache reads / 2.5% fresh input / 0.5% output
standardTokenMix.note: 固定比较口径，不代表任何平台或用户的实际负载；三项合计100%。当前不单列cache write；厂商另收缓存写入费时，换算可能偏高估token。2026-09-23 由 97.5%/2.15%/0.35% 修订为本值：standard-token-mix-round2-2026-09-23.json 14样本审计（输出中位0.51%、输入中位2.79%、剔除网关池化96.89/2.57/0.54），裁定。

lowCacheTokenMix.labelZh: 低缓存负载：缓存读取85% / 普通输入14.5% / 输出0.5%
lowCacheTokenMix.labelEn: Low-cache workload: 85% cache reads / 14.5% fresh input / 0.5% output
lowCacheTokenMix.note: 2026-09-22 裁定的第二档统一负载，用于实测打不到标准 97% cache 的渠道（当前：Step 全系、Google——Gemini 实测 82.6% 属同族，2026-09-30 裁定其实测样本按标价折 worth 后用本档换算）。锚点：step-5-preview 本机实测 mix 79.0%/20.7%/0.34%（210.17M tokens，stepfun-step5-panel-round5-2026-09-21.json）与 Google AI Pro 实测 82.6%，统一取 85% 档；step5 采用值的 decision_note 内保留 79% 实测口径对照数。非cache部分输出占比 0.5% 跟随标准负载、余量归输入。2026-09-23 随标准档由 85%/14.65%/0.35% 修订（standard-token-mix-round2-2026-09-23.json）。

anthropicTokenMix.labelZh: Anthropic 统一负载：缓存读97% / 缓存写2.5% / 输出0.5%
anthropicTokenMix.labelEn: Anthropic workload: 97% cache reads / 2.5% cache writes / 0.5% output
anthropicTokenMix.note: Anthropic 单独收缓存写入费，未命中缓存的输入几乎全部走缓存写（Devin 面板 input 0.001%/write 7.67%；MiaAI Claude Code 样本 input 0.14%/write 2.05%），故标准档的普通输入份额对 Anthropic 按 5 分钟缓存写入价计；份额与 standardTokenMix 联动（cacheWrite = standard.input）。2026-09-24 裁定。

collection.account_identity: A04 and A06 are anonymous labels for independent repeated measurements, not service account ids and not a pool to be added together. No identity map is exported.
collection.tool: Magpie aligned request log with supplied pure-model cluster endpoints
collection.quota_endpoint_source: Supplied pure_model_clusters. Raw quota history is not part of this public file.
collection.deduplication: Do not collapse equal token vectors: absent request ids, equal values alone do not prove duplication.
collection.counted_calls: Positive-token Claude Opus 5.5 calls inside the selected contiguous pure-model intervals. Zero-token rows, including one A04 gemini-4-argon error row, are not capacity samples.

qualification_policy.interpretation: Local evidence rubric; thresholds are not vendor rules or confidence probabilities

methodology.equation: weekly_official_api_equivalent_usd = 100 * sum(sample official API value USD) / sum(delta percentage points)
methodology.unit: USD per week for one anonymous account using only Claude Opus 5.5 until 100% of the weekly quota, at the observed cache mix
methodology.effective_segments: (sum(delta_pp))^2 / sum(delta_pp^2), after merging contiguous pure-model runs
methodology.leave_one_out: Maximum relative change in the pooled estimate after dropping one whole contiguous run. Undefined for a single run, which fails medium.
methodology.rounding: Conservative 1pp uncertainty per merged run, divided by total delta. The published range is a sensitivity envelope from request-timestamp shifts of +/-120s and +/-300s and each run delta +/-1pp. It is not a statistical confidence interval.
methodology.token_semantics: Official Anthropic input_tokens exclude cache reads and cache creation. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are parts of cache creation, not charges on top of the creation total. Output includes thinking; do not add reasoning again. Collector-adapter equivalence is assumed, and the alternate maximum-overlap input treatment is inside the sensitivity envelope.
not_used: No subscription price was used to fit or check the estimate.
Daily and weekly pools are not added.
methodology.scope: One anonymous subscription account × one model × 100% of the weekly quota, official API equivalent at the observed workload only.

official_facts.context: Full 1M context at standard prices. No batch, fast-mode, region, tool or tax premium is assumed.

confidence_assessment.rounding_basis: Conservative sum of 1pp remaining-difference uncertainty per contiguous run / total delta; aggregate-only 1pp ratio also reported.

plan_identity.note: No invoice or tier evidence; no plan value used to validate estimate.

limitations: Only supplied anonymous aligned requests and supplied cluster endpoints were available. Endpoint authenticity, omitted stream activity, cycle markers and anomaly exclusions are not independently authenticated.

No daily/weekly summing, cross-account pooling, known-plan calibration or automatic adopted-value change.

verification_summary.independent_recalculation: Request-level official-value fields in the reviewed alignment reproduce exactly. Cache-creation total equals the 5-minute plus 1-hour subcounts.
verification_summary.medium_rule: Whole contiguous pure-model runs, not sub-bins. A04 and A06 meet medium and miss high (calls below 200 and effective segments below 4).
verification_summary.limits: Interval identity, pre-rebound selection and purity beyond the supplied windows are contributor assertions. No invoice, raw quota history or adapter audit is in this public file. The envelope describes the observed cache-heavy workload only.
